changes: Adds optional robot safety review fields with source-bound documented or not-confirmed states and a neutral unknown default.
Adds a separate incident register with attributed control-mode reports, uncertainty and optional validated robot references.
Adds optional media type, publisher relation and concrete robot variant to claim sources.
Adds optional per-claim source review status, method, checked date and reason.
Adds optional evidence dates and explicit video segment end timestamps.
Adds optional, additive simulation research records with targeted-search status, sourced artifacts, provenance, revision, license and documented or tested simulator compatibility.
Adds optional, additive actuator architecture research records with targeted-search status, sourced joint groups, evidence status, drive, transmission, motion and architecture.
Adds optional delivery evidence records for sourced physical receipt claims that do not establish an exact delivery date.
Adds optional delivery evidence kind and named-customer metadata so receipt, deployment, pilot and arrival records can be queried without changing the global delivery status.
